title: Rejected packed native draw-state ABI
decision: Rejected; all packet runtime/native-core changes reverted
scope: Two localhost Chromium 151 clients on one AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 / Radeon 890M host; 960x720 picture within 1280x720. Captured cadence is not physical scanout or input-to-photon. 1800 forward frames per client with 15-130ms synthetic input delays. Controls use the experimental core with the packet path disabled.

diagnosis.nativeScratch: One 7183-byte malloc per renderer, aligned to 7168 usable bytes; not per draw. Replica creates a renderer each forward frame.
diagnosis.ownedPackets: 311 retained slots on Battlefield, 397 on Fountain; every model and immediate callback copied all six blocks, including unused rows, and compared blocks before reuse.
diagnosis.lostExistingOptimization: Packet model reader used renderer-local model staging rather than the existing cross-frame cache slots. A source-level fix was drafted but never synchronized, built or measured; it was reverted with the rejected experiment.
diagnosis.causalLimit: No substage profile completed. The implementation adds native packing, an owned copy, exact comparisons and repeated model staging allocations, but their individual contribution to the measured slowdown is not isolated.
diagnosis.stopped: After B2, before profiles or broad heavy/oracle/stage suites. Those validations were not run for this rejected candidate.
